name: openbao
description: OpenBao is a software solution to manage, store, and distribute sensitive data including secrets, certificates, and keys.
one_liner: An open-source vault that securely stores and manages passwords, API keys, and certificates for companies, so secrets aren't scattered in code or spreadsheets.
buyer: A DevOps or security lead at a mid-size company who needs a self-hosted alternative to commercial secrets-management tools for cost or compliance reasons.
business_use_cases: A company avoiding vendor lock-in migrates off a paid commercial secrets manager onto this self-hosted alternative.
A managed-hosting provider offers 'OpenBao as a service' for companies that want the tool but not the ops burden.
A security consultancy audits and hardens a client's secrets-management setup using it as the reference implementation.

money_ideas.idea: Managed hosting/operations of the vault for companies that don't want to run it themselves.
Security audit and migration consulting for companies moving off a paid competitor.

steal_this: Stand up a managed hosting offering this weekend targeted at startups currently paying for a pricier commercial secrets manager.
